SU directory ↗

Less scrolling. More showing up.

Free food brings people together. This student-built prototype puts event details in one place, with the original source always close by.

Find the useful posts

We start with the public Durham SU society directory and supported public event feeds. Instagram and Facebook profiles are linked where available; their posts need an accessible feed or a reviewed submission.

Keep the details clear

Each live event needs a source, a date and an explicit free-food offer. Entry fees are separate from food. Missing prices, dietary details or deadlines are labelled as unknown.

Keep the menu fresh

The repository checks sources each evening around 8pm UK time. Started events fade for the rest of that day, then disappear from the feed. All times use Europe/London.

Source coverage

Checking source status…

A linked society profile does not mean its social posts are being collected. Always check the organiser’s latest post before heading out.
